rationale: Both responses do the same thing: they check that no perfect square from 4 to 49 divides 53, confirm 53 is prime by testing primes up to 7, and conclude that sqrt(53) is already in simplest form. The reasoning is identical. B is marginally more precise in notation, writing the non-terminating quotients as approximations (53/9 approx 5.89) where A writes them as equalities. That is a very small edge in correctness of presentation.
